findings.museum: Three cabinet configurations each complete six visits. Actual room frames show clear side corridors and open-glass tray service; transparent DOM buttons no longer paint frames on top of the actor.
findings.tape: New fixed frame, registered spindle and a connected strip. 0/I/II use the same mechanism. The A-state lint mat is visibly brushed off; no old paper bridges, stacks or purple strips are used in active rendering.
findings.bell: Fixed shell/collar/base; hand reaches cap, depresses stem, triggers only at contact, releases and withdraws beyond viewport. No whole-bell screenshot rotation.
findings.preserved: Modern single-sheet receipt, readable specific interactions, dense pixel controls and the remaining three curios preserve the preceding approved direction.
